name: Compute Cluster S60: Correlation, Covariance & Beta
description: Tests: rolling_corr(window, method, window_type), ewm_corr(span), rolling_cov(window), ewm_cov(span), beta(window). Pairwise statistical measures on SPY vs QQQ.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S60: Correlation, Covariance & Beta
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c

ret = returns(close)
ref_ret = returns(ref_close)

# === ROLLING CORRELATION ===
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(ret, ref_ret)

# === EWM CORRELATION ===
corr_ewm = ewm_corr(span=30)(ret, ref_ret)

# === ROLLING COVARIANCE ===
cov_60 = rolling_cov(window=60)(ret, ref_ret)

# === EWM COVARIANCE ===
cov_ewm = ewm_cov(span=30)(ret, ref_ret)

# === BETA ===
b = beta(window=60)(ret, ref_ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation SPY vs QQQ (60d)',
    category='Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pearson Corr', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_60)

xy_lines(
    title='EWM Correlation (span=30)',
    category='Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EWM Corr', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_ewm)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Beta (60d)',
    category='Beta',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Beta', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=b)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Covariance (60d)',
    category='Covariance',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Covariance', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cov_60)
